subject: general
question: In Flemming's left hand rule; the thumb, fore finger and centre finger respectively represent,

options.text: Direction of magnetic field, current and force experienced
Direction of magnetic field, force experienced and current
Direction of force experienced, magnetic field and current
Direction of current, magnetic field and force experienced

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Direction of force experienced,magnetic field and current'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When **a current-carrying conductor** is **placed** in an external magnetic field, the conductor **experiences a force perpendicular** to both the field and the current flow’s direction.
 
• **Fleming’s left-hand rule** is used to find the direction of the force acting on **the current carrying conductor placed in a magnetic field.** 
 
• **Fleming’s Left Hand Rule** states that if we arrange our** thumb, forefinger and middle finger** of the **left-hand perpendicular** to each other, then the thumb points towards the direction of the force experienced by the conductor, the **forefinger** points towards the direction of the **magnetic field **and the **middle finger** points towards the direction of the **electric current.**
